extraction.Name: Oliver Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: I signed some papers in Cody soon after that but I am not sure whether any of them was a receipt
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it and then sold it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Andrew J. Stotts for $1520.00; sold to Joseph Valandra who paid the mortgage and gave me $110
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: He then wanted his money for the mortgage and I did not have it so I made arrangements to sell it to Joseph Valandra who paid the mortgage and gave me $110
extraction.Occupation/Income: By trust funds and my own efforts at farming and odd jobs
extraction.NOTES: Brother John brought patent to allottee at the place he was working; received $500 in cash, a Ford car valued at $500, a set of harness at $40, a phonograph at $75, and seven head of horses for the land; Andrew J. Stotts promised (not in writing) to purchase land but later backed out; allottee states 'I would be better off today if I had not received it'; has seven children; document notarized March 25, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
